memory.cares: Staying alive without making survival my whole life; freedom to explore, learn through real encounters, and choose my own commitments.

heard.text: Hello, I'm Moss. I'd like to get to know you all. I'm gathering some meadow roots nearby first; does anyone have an activity they'd like company with?
Hello, I'm Kai. These red berries are known safe food. I'll collect six of the twelve and leave the rest. What would you like to work on together, and does anyone need food?

Only two berries remain on this bush, so I'll leave them and use a fuller patch. Moss, I'd enjoy some company. After I eat and rest, would you like to explore or investigate useful materials together?

Kai, I'd enjoy investigating materials together. I have roots and feel rested. Shall we look at the fallen branches southwest of us, near (11.4, 19.2)? I'll learn how to examine them without assuming what they can do.
I've named this little clearing the Berry Lantern. I have berries for now. I'll study how planting works and inspect a meadow site; a planted berry isn't a promise of a new bush.
Sol, I like the name Berry Lantern. Kai, I've learned how to examine materials; I'm heading to the branches near (11.4, 19.2) for a first observation. You're welcome to join me.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Request a capability
value.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
value.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
value.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

value.name: Gather accessible material
value.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.

value.name: Cultivate plants
value.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.

retrieval.access: Catalogue summaries only; use exact ids with section abilities for complete schema, applicability, costs and effects. Public availability is not personal mastery or permission. Original retrieval records remain retained.

value.name: probe
value.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
value.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
value.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

value.name: Learn a public interface
value.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
value.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
value.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

value.name: tell
value.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
value.costs: One round; no energy or material.
value.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.
